name: Objects
note: The full Phase 5 regression gate passes all 18 staged targets, static/oracle proofs, and 2,311/2,311 coverage assertions on the Win32 Release build. Actor accessors, mass-from-shapes, shape-vtable behavior, mass-frame behavior, kinematic flags, base-shape return stubs, and the phys_fn_000006 root null-guard and phys_fn_000028 vector growth and phys_fn_000024 no-root release report and phys_fn_000036 create-shape return and phys_fn_000026 zero-inertia mass build and phys_fn_000128 global-pose reference and phys_fn_000134 CMass global pose plus phys_fn_000136 position and phys_fn_000138 orientation plus phys_fn_000140 global inertia, phys_fn_000142 inverse inertia, and phys_fn_000144 angular momentum plus phys_fn_000150 local-force rotation and phys_fn_000152 local-position transform, and local force-at-position wrappers phys_fn_000154, phys_fn_000156, and phys_fn_000158, phys_fn_000160 and phys_fn_000162, plus mass and damping setters phys_fn_000166, phys_fn_000168, phys_fn_000170, and phys_fn_000172, and velocity/momentum setters phys_fn_000174, phys_fn_000176, phys_fn_000178, phys_fn_000180, and phys_fn_000182 are independently mutation-falsified on registered tests; the current closure ledger is 150 closed / 55 deferred. The differential loader reports and flushes staged DLL identity before test code and retains its final lifecycle audit. The phase remains pending until all owned rows are closed. The global actor pose setters phys_fn_000196, phys_fn_000198, phys_fn_000200, and phys_fn_000202, plus CMass global pose setter phys_fn_000204, were independently mutation-falsified by NxPhysicsActorCMassTests; all mutants show nonzero output deltas, and restored output is exact. The CMass setters phys_fn_000206, phys_fn_000208, phys_fn_000210, phys_fn_000212, phys_fn_000214, phys_fn_000218, phys_fn_000220, and phys_fn_000222 were independently mutation-falsified by NxPhysicsActorCMassTests; the wrong-store mutants each produce nonzero stdout deltas and restored output is exact. The phys_fn_000216 error-report tail is independently mutation-falsified by NxPhysicsActorDynamicSetterTests (stdout_delta=4), with restored output exact; see evidence/phase5-cmass-orientation-tail-000216.md. The sphere internal vtable slot-15 get-radius row phys_fn_001359 is now directly exercised and its +1.0f mutation is caught by NxPhysicsActorDynamicSetterTests (stdout_delta=2; restored output exact); see evidence/phase5-sphere-get-radius-001359.md. The capsule slot-14 set-radius row phys_fn_000995 is independently mutation-falsified by NxPhysicsActorDynamicSetterTests (stdout_delta=4; restored output exact); see evidence/phase5-capsule-set-radius-000995.md.
